prompt:
I'm going to travel from May 25 to June 29.
First, I'm going to Halle (Saale), Germany.

During my travel I want to visit Italy (Florence, Rom, Pisa, Capri, Milan), Switzerland (Lugano), Netherlands (Amesterdam, Maastricht), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), France (Paris, Lyon), Germany (Berlin, Dresden) and Prague.

From May 25-May 29 I want to stay in Halle (Saale), Dresden, Leipzig and Berlin.

I want to visit Prague for only two days, only from June 14-June 16.

After visiting Milan, I want to go Lugano straight and come back to Milan.

I also don't want to visit Venice.

I want to have three days in Paris.

I want to go to the Netherlands from either Paris or Berlin.

On June 27 I want to go back to Halle.

Help me to plan my travel.
answer:
| Dates | Overnight base | Plan |
|---|---|---|
| **May 25** | Halle (Saale) | Arrive and explore Halle’s old town. |
| **May 26** | Leipzig | Train to Leipzig, about 30 minutes. Visit the historic centre and St. Thomas Church. |
| **May 27** | Dresden | Train to Dresden, about 1–1½ hours. Explore the Frauenkirche, Zwinger and riverfront. |
| **May 28–29** | Berlin | Travel to Berlin on May 28, about 2 hours by train. Spend May 29 sightseeing. |
| **May 30–June 1** | Amsterdam | Travel **directly from Berlin to the Netherlands** on May 30, roughly 6 hours by train. You then have two full days for Amsterdam. |
| **June 2** | Maastricht | Train to Maastricht, about 2½ hours. Explore the old town and riverside. |
| **June 3** | Paris | Travel to Paris via Liège or Brussels. Allow approximately 3–5 hours, depending on connections. |
| **June 4–6** | Paris | **Three full days in Paris:** one for the Eiffel Tower and Seine, one for the Louvre and central Paris, and one for Montmartre and your remaining priorities. |
| **June 7** | Lyon | Take an early train to Lyon, about 2 hours. Explore Vieux Lyon and Fourvière, then enjoy dinner in a traditional bouchon. |
| **June 8–10** | Barcelona | Travel to Barcelona on June 8. A direct train from Lyon takes around 5 hours when operating. Spend June 9–10 exploring Barcelona. |
| **June 11–13** | Madrid | High-speed train to Madrid on June 11, about 2½–3 hours. Spend June 12–13 visiting the Prado, Retiro Park and historic centre. |
| **June 14–15** | Prague | Fly from Madrid to Prague on **June 14**, preferably early. Explore the Old Town, Charles Bridge and Prague Castle over these two sightseeing days. |
| **June 16** | Naples | Leave Prague on **June 16** and fly to Naples. Take an evening walk through Naples if arrival time permits. |
| **June 17** | Naples | **Capri day trip:** take a morning ferry to Capri and return to Naples that evening. |
| **June 18–20** | Rome | Train to Rome on June 18, around 1–1½ hours. Use June 19–20 for ancient Rome and the Vatican, with evenings around the historic centre. |
| **June 21–22** | Florence | Train to Florence on June 21, about 1½ hours. Explore the cathedral area, Renaissance art and riverside. |
| **June 23** | Florence | **Pisa day trip**, approximately 1 hour each way by train. Return to Florence for the night. |
| **June 24** | Milan | Train to Milan, approximately 2 hours. Visit the Duomo, Galleria and central Milan. |
| **June 25** | Milan | Travel **Milan → Lugano → Milan** by direct train, roughly 1¼ hours each way. Spend the day beside the lake and exploring Lugano. |
| **June 26** | Milan | Full day in Milan for remaining sights and a relaxed final evening in Italy. |
| **June 27** | Halle (Saale) | Return to Halle. A practical option is a flight from Milan to Berlin followed by a train to Halle; allow most of the day. |
| **June 28** | Halle (Saale) | Rest, explore locally and prepare for your departure. |
| **June 29** | — | Depart from Halle toward your onward destination. |

This order keeps most journeys moving geographically: **Germany → Netherlands → France → Spain → Prague → southern Italy → northern Italy and Lugano → Halle.** Venice is excluded.

A few details matter when booking:

- **Prague:** June 14–16 means **two nights**, with sightseeing on June 14–15 and departure on June 16. Flight timing will determine how much of June 14 you have.
- **Paris:** Four nights give you the requested **three complete sightseeing days**, June 4–6.
- **Capri:** Staying in Naples makes the island visit simpler and avoids moving your luggage onto ferries. Choose a return sailing with some flexibility for weather.
- **Transport:** Check the proposed flights **Madrid–Prague on June 14, Prague–Naples on June 16, and Milan–Berlin on June 27** before booking accommodation. Direct services and operating days need confirmation for your travel year.
- Reserve popular timed attractions ahead, especially the **Sagrada Família, Louvre, Vatican Museums, Colosseum, Uffizi and Milan’s Last Supper**. Train times above are approximate.
